description: "Working seamlessly with the split datasets generated by <code>yukiSH</code>, this package calculates split-half reliability across six key metrics: reaction time (RT), accuracy (ACC), efficiency (RT/ACC), d-prime, DDM drift rate (v), and DDM starting point (z).
